evals.prompt: crea un spring boot api para gestionar usuarios (nombre, email, password). Necesito listar, obtener por id y crear.
evals.expected_output: Maven project with Java 25 and Boot 4.x, artifactId equal to the workspace directory, base package com.markcode.claude.springboot.<artifactId>.app, layered packages, User entity, UserRepository, UserDto record without password or audit fields, UserMapper, UserService, UserController, application.properties, Maven Wrapper. The config package exists (with package-info) for Spring/Security configuration.

assertions.text: pom.xml has groupId com.markcode.claude.springboot and artifactId equal to the workspace directory name
pom.xml sets java.version 25 and jar packaging
mvnw, mvnw.cmd and .mvn/ exist
Config is src/main/resources/application.properties and no application.yml/yaml exists
Packages controllers, services, repositories, models, dto and mapper exist under the base package
Package config exists under the base package (empty with package-info.java is acceptable) and no @Configuration class lives outside it
UserDto is a Java record and has no password, createdAt, updatedAt, createAt or updateAt component
UserController has no import or field of UserRepository and no business logic
UserRepository is an interface extending JpaRepository
UserMapper is a handwritten class with toDto and toEntity and no MapStruct/ModelMapper dependency in the pom
Classes use constructor injection and no field @Autowired
./mvnw -DskipTests package succeeds

evals.prompt: add a Product entity (name, price, sku unique) to the existing spring boot project with its repository, service and a controller with create endpoint. Validate that price is positive.
evals.expected_output: Product model, ProductRepository, ProductDto record, ProductMapper, ProductService with business rule for duplicate sku, ProductController using @Valid, following the conventions already in the project.

assertions.text: ProductDto uses Jakarta validation (@NotBlank, @Positive or @DecimalMin) on name and price
Duplicate sku is checked in ProductService, not in the controller
Controller returns a DTO (ResponseEntity<ProductDto>) and never the Product entity
New classes are placed in the existing controllers/services/repositories/models/dto/mapper packages
The existing project is inspected before generating (no second pom or duplicated base class)

evals.prompt: genera un spring mvc con thymeleaf y tailwind, una pagina home y una lista de tareas (titulo, hecha). Quiero layout base con header, navbar y footer.
evals.expected_output: Monolithic MVC app: templates/layouts/base.html, fragments header/navbar/footer, pages/, semantic header/main/footer, @Controller delegating to a TaskService, DTOs passed to the model, Tailwind CSS output in static/css, Thymeleaf starter in the pom.

assertions.text: templates/layouts/base.html, fragments/header.html, navbar.html, footer.html and pages/ exist
base layout uses <header>, <main> and <footer> elements
pom.xml includes the Thymeleaf starter
Page controller depends on TaskService only and puts DTOs, not entities, in the Model
Layered packages and explicit TaskMapper are present
The run instructions use ./mvnw -DskipTests spring-boot:run

evals.prompt: agrega spring security con jwt stateless al proyecto, que el front de react en localhost:5173 pueda llamar a /api, y deja el health de actuator publico
evals.expected_output: spring-boot-starter-security added to the pom; SecurityConfig (SecurityFilterChain, PasswordEncoder, CORS source) and typed AppProperties placed in the config package (JWT filter/service in config/security if created); health permitted; secrets from environment variables; UserDetailsService in services.

assertions.text: pom.xml includes the Spring Security starter
SecurityConfig is in the config package and defines a SecurityFilterChain bean with STATELESS session policy
Every @Configuration/@ConfigurationProperties class is inside config/ (or config/security/)
/actuator/health is permitAll in the filter chain
CORS allowed origins come from properties (app.cors.allowed-origins), not hard-coded
JWT secret is read from an environment variable placeholder in application.properties and not committed in plain text
UserDetailsService (or equivalent user lookup) lives in services/ and config/ does not import any repository
PasswordEncoder bean exists and no plain-text password comparison is used

evals.prompt: agrega un chat en tiempo real con websocket y stomp: varios usuarios, mensajes que se distribuyan a los demas, guardados en h2, historial por rest y aviso cuando alguien entra o sale
evals.expected_output: WebSocketConfig in config/ with /ws endpoint, simple broker and /app prefix; @MessageMapping join/send in controllers delegating to services; messages persisted with server-side author and timestamp; presence on a topic via session disconnect event; REST history and connected users; errors sent to the offending session; integration test with real STOMP clients.

assertions.text: pom.xml includes spring-boot-starter-websocket
WebSocketConfig is in config/ and enables a simple broker with an /app application prefix
STOMP handlers (@MessageMapping) are in controllers/ and only delegate to services
The message author is derived from the session, not from the client payload, and the timestamp is set by the server
DTOs are records and do not expose the session id
Disconnection is handled by a SessionDisconnectEvent listener that publishes presence
Message time column is not named plain 'timestamp' in the database (H2 reserved word)
An integration test with WebSocketStompClient exists and ./mvnw test passes
